run.description: Remove a skill from the yard
does: removes the skill notes from the yard: its directory /synthetic/yard/skills/notes and all 2 entries of its tree.
Its description: Write release notes & "quotes" café 🙂
The crew member clerk is given the skills notes now, and will be given no skills.
No session of the crew member clerk runs now.
The group builders is given the skills notes, triage now, and will be given the skills triage.
No session of the group builders runs now.
The group web/reviewers is given the skills notes now, and will be given no skills.
No session of the group web/reviewers runs now.

The yard's server carries the removal out after the approval, as one operation that takes the skill off its holders and records skill_removed together; the tree and holders are held to these again first.
